files.note: Truncated from 92 real build entries to 7 (top 3 STABLE, top 2 BETA, top 2 ALPHA by build id) to keep the file small while still exercising the STABLE/BETA/ALPHA channel-selection logic.

Truncated from 907 real entries to 11: the 2 newest snapshots, the latest release (26.2), one older release (26.1.2), a 1.20-floor boundary release (1.21.11), the two releases either side of the 1.20 floor (1.20.1, 1.20), one pre-floor release (1.19.4), one legacy release (1.16.5), and the two oldest historical entries (rd-132328, rd-132211). The 'latest' object is kept as recorded by Mojang.

Truncated from the real per-version metadata: 'libraries' cut from 131 entries to 3, 'arguments.game'/'arguments.jvm' each cut to their first 5 entries. 'downloads' (including 'downloads.server', the field VanillaDownloader actually reads), 'javaVersion', 'assetIndex', and every other top-level field are kept in full.
Truncated from 67 real entries to 12: the 6 newest, 3 more stable=true entries, and 3 older stable releases spanning the 1.20 floor (1.20.1, 1.19.4, 1.16.5).

Truncated from 251 real entries to the top 3 (highest loader build first, matching the oracle's 'first stable' selection); each entry's launcherMeta.libraries lists cut to their first 2 items per platform group.
Truncated from 67 real entries to the first 8 (newest first, matching the oracle's 'first stable' selection).

Truncated from 1662 real <version> entries to 7, chosen to span NeoForge's Minecraft-version eras: one beta (20.2.12-beta), one stable per MC 1.20.2/1.20.4/1.21.1/1.21.4 era, and the two newest stable releases (26.1.2.95, 26.2.0.61 = <latest>/<release>). groupId, artifactId, latest, release, and lastUpdated are kept as recorded.

Truncated from 5040 real <version> entries to 9: the highest build for MC 1.20/1.20.1/1.20.4/1.20.6/1.21/1.21.1/1.21.5, plus the array's own first and last entries (1.21.11-61.0.0 and 1.21.5-55.1.13 = <latest>/<release>). Finding: <latest>/<release> (1.21.5-55.1.13) is stale relative to the newest entry actually present in <versions> (1.21.11-61.0.0) -- Forge's own maven-metadata.xml under-reports its newest version, which is presumably why the oracle's latestRecommendedVersion() reads promotions_slim.json instead of trusting this tag.

Not named in this step's file list, but captured in full (4082 bytes, no truncation needed) because NeoForgeInstaller.swift's latestRecommendedVersion() -- characterized by P7.5/P7.7 -- reads this endpoint, not maven-metadata.xml's <latest> tag, for Forge's actual recommended-version resolution.
